title: Every SaaS rebuilds the same infrastructure. AI made it faster — and less consistent.
lede: Before you write your product, you need logins, payments, team invites, and permissions. Most founders use AI to build. Nearly every session improvises the same thing differently.
marketScale: We start where every product starts: logins and payments. Once Fonderie defines your foundation, the same standard extends to notifications, permissions, and mobile. The wedge is the first five systems. The market is the infrastructure budget of every AI-built company.
ledeCombined: Before you write your product, you need auth, billing, teams, permissions. AI improvises all of it differently every session. In 2026, most SaaS founders use AI assistants to build. Nearly all of them are improvising the same infrastructure, differently every session. Fonderie is the control layer — one system that directs AI to build correctly, however you ship.

items.title: Logins
items.text: AI improvises every session. Different bugs. Different APIs. Inconsistent security.

items.title: Payments
items.text: AI wires Stripe differently every time. Some sessions forget webhooks. Others skip invoice logic.

items.title: Team invites
items.text: AI builds access control differently each time. One session uses roles. Another uses flags. Neither matches your logins.

items.title: Email
items.text: AI reinvents email every session. Templates, queues, retry logic — rebuilt from scratch, differently every time.

items.title: Security
items.text: AI skips rate limiting in some sessions. Hardcodes secrets in others. No two builds handle logins the same way.

byHandText: 2–3 months and $30,000–$60,000. And you still have to get auth right.
withAiText: Your assistant improvises from scratch every session — different login flows, different billing logic, different bugs. It wastes hours (and your AI budget) debugging the same problems over and over.
withFonderieText: Fonderie's control layer specifies and verifies every build. Same login flow every time. Same billing logic. Same security. You spend your time talking to customers. Without Fonderie, every AI session starts from zero — it doesn't know your auth, your billing, your stack. Fonderie is the standard that remembers, so the AI doesn't have to.
